# Copilot Instructions

- **Purpose**: Fine-tune MedGemma-27B (8-bit) with LoRA for drug–drug interaction (DDI) relation classification; keep workflows aligned with existing scripts and data layout.
- **Code map**: Training entrypoint is [finetune_medgemma_lora.py](finetune_medgemma_lora.py) calling modular helpers in [modules/data_utils.py](modules/data_utils.py), [modules/model_utils.py](modules/model_utils.py), [modules/training_utils.py](modules/training_utils.py), and [modules/utils.py](modules/utils.py). Evaluation/inference baseline lives in [ddi_predict_evaluate.py](ddi_predict_evaluate.py). Data construction lives under [data_process](data_process/README_finetune.md).
- **Data format**: Fine-tuning CSVs must expose `input_text` and `output_text` columns; datasets are split in-code if no explicit test CSV is provided. Processed LoRA data defaults to [data/processed_lora_data_base.csv](data/processed_lora_data_base.csv). Many raw/augmented splits already exist in [data](data).
- **Prompting pattern**: Training uses `tokenizer.apply_chat_template` on a user/assistant pair created in `format_dataset` to preserve MedGemma chat formatting. `ddi_predict_evaluate` builds strict few-shot prompts and extracts labels from model text output; keep label set in sync with `DDI_TYPES` there.
- **Training workflow**: Run `python finetune_medgemma_lora.py` with optional flags (`--model_id`, `--train_data`, `--output_dir`, `--batch_size`, `--gradient_accumulation_steps`, `--learning_rate`, `--max_steps`, `--r`, `--lora_alpha`, `--packing`, `--use_quantization` for remote models, `--no_multi_gpu` to disable multi-GPU). Outputs land in `results/medgemma_ddi_lora` with a saved `final_model` subdir plus generated inference script and requirements.
- **Model loading quirks**: Default assumes local fixed configs in [models/google/medgemma-27b-it-8bit](models/google/medgemma-27b-it-8bit). `load_model_and_tokenizer` sets `device_map="balanced"` when multi-GPU, applies `prepare_model_for_kbit_training`, and forces `pad_token=eos_token`. Local paths skip extra quantization flags; remote models optionally use 8-bit via `BitsAndBytesConfig`. `check_bitsandbytes` warns if missing or outdated.
- **LoRA target pattern**: `configure_lora` applies adapters to attention projections (`q_proj`, `k_proj`, `v_proj`, `o_proj`) and MLP projections (`gate_proj`, `up_proj`, `down_proj`). If you add layers, keep this list consistent with Gemma block names.
- **Trainer defaults**: `setup_training_args` uses cosine LR, fp16, gradient checkpointing, `logging_steps=50`, `save_steps=200`, `eval_steps=100`, and `load_best_model_at_end`. Eval strategy is step-based; metrics are printed after training and saved via `SFTTrainer.evaluate`.
- **Inference path**: `generate_inference_script` writes [inference_medgemma_lora.py](inference_medgemma_lora.py) that loads base model plus LoRA adapter from `results/.../final_model`, uses chat template, and runs with low-temp decoding. Reuse `DDIInference.generate_response` for quick tests.
- **Evaluation script**: [ddi_predict_evaluate.py](ddi_predict_evaluate.py) reads tab-separated test data (defaults to [data/test_augmented_data.csv](data/test_augmented_data.csv)), builds rich prompts (`create_prompt_shot`/`create_prompt`), generates predictions with ModelScope `AutoModelForCausalLM`, and writes TSV predictions plus weighted and per-class metrics to console and `test_predict.csv`. Keep outputs UTF-8 with tab delimiter.
- **Data pipeline (mechanism/PrimeKG)**: [data_process/README_finetune.md](data_process/README_finetune.md) documents building finetuning inputs from `mechanism.json` + PrimeKG via `build_finetune_dataset.py`, then generating outputs with `generate_outputs.py` (expects `primekg_graph.pkl`). Defaults create `finetune_dataset_test.json` and can scale to full set. Preserve this flow when regenerating data.
- **Dependencies**: `create_requirements_file` emits pinned packages (transformers 4.36.0, torch 2.1.0, accelerate/peft/trl/datasets/pandas/numpy, optional bitsandbytes). Prefer Python 3.10 env; GPU recommended (>=24GB). Avoid altering large model binaries under `models/google`.
- **Conventions**: Logging uses prints; seeds via `set_random_seed`. Multi-GPU is on by default; disable explicitly if needed. Keep new prompts consistent with existing instruction style and label taxonomy. Use English for code/comments unless matching surrounding text.
- **Outputs/paths**: Results are written relative to repo root (e.g., `results/medgemma_ddi_lora`). Scripts create directories automatically; avoid changing file encodings. Large intermediate files (predictions, datasets) live under `data` and `results`—reuse paths instead of inventing new ones unless required.
- **Safety**: Many files are large (model shards). Do not move or commit them. Be cautious when editing generated configs; local model configs already include fixed `quant_method` values used by loaders.
